div.div:
PtpConfigs
• test-wpc-grandmaster — worker3, ens7f0 + ens7f1 (same WPC NIC; GNSS → ts2phc → PHC)
Requirements
• Westport Channel (E810-XXVDA4T) NIC
• Connected GNSS on that NIC
• Two ports on the same NIC
Not in netdevsim CI
Solver needs StepIsWPCNic + HasGNSSDevice. Diagram shows role placement only.
ptpcimno lab
CUT on cnfdf31 NIC4 ens4* or cnfdf32 NIC6 ens7*.
